{{Top|leg}}
A '''shipjacking kit''' was a highly regulated and normally illegal security code descrambler. Authorized [[Skip tracer/Legends|skip tracers]] were the only individuals legally allowed to own them. Unauthorized possession of shipjacking kits was a crime on most [[Planet/Legends|planets]]. They generally cost 8,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to licensed individuals, and at least 16,000 credits on the [[Invisible Market]].
